title: Carefree, Trotting Along, Ready to Roll!

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Attendant
text_block_list.text:
Taiyaki! Taiyaki! Get yer taiyaki hot and
steamin' right off the press!
This'll be
today's last!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: One taiyaki pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wh-wh-whoa, sorry! Please, go on
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, we kinda both got here at the same
time and... Oh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Soft and flaky, chewy-gooey
deliciousness. And now I'm stuffed!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nah nah, snacks are even tastier when you
share! And you're a trainer
at the
academy, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
This has gotta be more than chance.
Hopefully we get to meet again
soon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And just a few days later...

text_block_list.name: Meat Bun Shop Attendant
text_block_list.text:
Meat buns, meat buns! Meet yer new
favorite snack—my last remainin'
meat bun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: One meat bun pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wh-wh-whoa, sorr— Geh, heeeh?
It's you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho, I s'pose lightning can strike the
same place twice. Shall we
go halfsies
today too? Heehee.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And after a few more days of our bellies
crying out at the same time
and place...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good morning! Hey hey, check out this
pic!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Muhuhu. Somehow someway, I managed to
snag that new spider
plushie! Isn't he so
cute?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've become something like small talk
buddies, and chats like this are common
whenever we run into each other in the
academy halls.
Then one day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several students are engaged in ramp
training, led by Mihono
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
First ramp dash complete. Commencing
second dash.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Is she really going for another? No waaay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew... This is rough!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Nooo... waaay... Haaa... Urgh, and here I
thought I finally... built up
some stamina.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though some of her peers seem to be
quite spent, Matikanetannhauser presses
behind Mihono Bourbon up the ramp
once
more.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... whew... huff!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Third run. Adding two hundred meters. Huff!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: M-me toooo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... phew... Couldn't quite... cut it... that time... Bourbon's really somethin' else... Wah!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, I'm okay,
I'm okay! My legs are just a
little shaky. Looks like I've
still got work to
do.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Really? 'Cause you were pretty awesome
up till those last three
hundred meters.
You were right on her tail!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's regimen is known
throughout the academy as being

especially tough. Most students give up
after one ramp dash.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, haven't they been at it for a while
now? Like over two hours or something at
this point?
Looks like they're really serious about
interval training.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Right behind, right behind, stay right... behind... Haaa, I'm totally at my limit!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... I gotta stop! Thought I had a bit more stamina than that!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
No, that was great! You put up a great
fight, Machitan.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well thank ya very kindly! Hm? Oh!
Now since when have you
been standin'
there?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Kinda wish you came when I was actually
running at my best. I really
thought I'd be
able to finish that round, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But ya know, I really did pick up on some
good long-distance tricks. Yeah, that was
a pretty good sesh. Gotta jot these down
before I
forget...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I need to think of more ways to raise my
stamina, and I should
probably try out a
form with less air resistance... Mun.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, while I've got you here, Trainer.
Um, would you mind giving
me some
pointers?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
My goal this month is to get tough! I
wanna up my stamina and really
work on
building slow-twitch muscle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hands me her notebook, which I
quickly take a look at. The training plan
neatly notated on the calendar appears
moderately
tough.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I don't think I quite have what it takes to compete with the best of the best yet. I'm trying not to push myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I just want to do what I can for now,
'cause
I know it'll all work out for
me eventually!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's amazingly positive, hardworking, and
down-to-earth. From the
little bit that I've
seen of her over the last few days, I feel
like we would make a good team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if she doesn't stand out so much yet,
I know that she definitely
has what it takes
to shine.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm? Somethin' up?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A contract? Oh, wait! Is this a scouting
offer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I definitely accept! A big welcome,
comin' from me to you, my
halfsies partner!
Here's to sharing a lot more than just
snacks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While quite normal in many ways,
Matikanetannhauser is just peculiar 
enough in others to ensure fun and
fruitful
days ahead.
